narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} the roof at home came up, and you chose {real_choice}, while the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. In month {layoff_month}, the month of the layoff and the month the money sat furthest apart, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion for a stretch with no pay finished {safety_gap}. Its sense of living rather than getting by came out {life_gap}.
